"""Observe the existing unsafe contract; this is not a passing safety test."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from runpy import run_path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from apps.data_center.application import query_services


def test_observe_existing_publication_and_current_availability_gap(monkeypatch):
    fixture = run_path("tests/unit/data_center/test_valuation_publication_sync.py")
    repository = fixture["_PublicationRepository"]()
    use_case = fixture["PublishValuationBatchUseCase"](
        fact_repository=fixture["_CandidateRepository"]([fixture["_reference"]()]),
        publication_repository=repository,
        policy_repository=fixture["_PolicyRepository"](),
    )
    publication = use_case.execute(
        [fixture["_fact"]()],
        provider_name="provider-main",
        published_at=fixture["PUBLISHED_AT"],
    )
    assert publication is not None
    assert repository.published[0][1][0].quality_status == "available_at_unverified"
    assert publication.must_not_use_for_decision is False
    repository.get_oldest_member_observed_at = lambda _identity: fixture["OBSERVED_AT"]
    monkeypatch.setattr(query_services, "get_canonical_publication_repository", lambda: repository)
    monkeypatch.setattr(query_services, "get_dataset_contract_repository", lambda: SimpleNamespace(
        get_active=lambda _dataset: SimpleNamespace(freshness_seconds=172800)
    ))
    gate = query_services._publication_gate(
        "equity.valuation.fact", "current", now=fixture["PUBLISHED_AT"]
    )
    assert gate is not None
    assert gate["freshness_status"] == "fresh"
    assert gate["must_not_use_for_decision"] is False
    Path("var/data02-existing-availability-gap-result-20260913.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "observation": "existing unsafe local Application contract, not production publication mutation",
        "member_quality_status": repository.published[0][1][0].quality_status,
        "fact_available_at": fixture["_fact"]().available_at,
        "publication_must_not_use_for_decision": publication.must_not_use_for_decision,
        "current_gate": gate,
        "control": "explicit fake 172800-second freshness policy keeps the historical fixture fresh",
        "required_next_action": "Source availability capture and fail-closed publication/current policy enforcement before DATA-02 publication.",
    }, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
